mechanics.claim: Viktor can augment each of his abilities at the cost of 100 Hex Fragments, which he gains from killing enemies.
mechanics.quote: '''Viktor''' can augment each of his {{tip|abilities}} at the cost of 100 ''Hex Fragments'', which he gains from killing enemies

mechanics.claim: Minions and monsters generate 1 Hex Fragment; siege minions, super minions, and epic monsters generate 10; enemy champion takedowns generate 20.
mechanics.quote:
{{tip|Minions}} and {{tip|monsters}} generate 1 ''Hex Fragment''.
* Siege minions, super minions, and epic monsters generate 10 ''Hex Fragments''.
* Enemy {{tip|champion}} {{tip|takedown|takedowns}} generate 20 ''Hex Fragments''.

mechanics.claim: Arcane Storm can only be augmented after all of Viktor's basic abilities have been augmented.
mechanics.quote: ''{{ai|Arcane Storm|Viktor}}'' can be augmented after all of '''Viktor's''' basic abilities have been augmented.
